simple.meaning: a Kittite or Cypriote ; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כִּתִּי (H3794) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.

definitions.short: a Kittite or Cypriote ; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine
definitions.full: H3794. Kitti or Kittiyyi [ כִּתִּי ] adjective, of a people always plural כִּתִּיִּים כִּתִּים ; usually as name, of a people = Cypriotes (compare Phoenician proper name, of a location כתי כת , Citium ; on a connection with Kheta , –-t¹, –attê , חִתִּי , see WMM Asien u. Europa,345 ; — on Citium see Cesnola Gyprus 46 ff ); — כִּתִּים אֶרֶץ Isa 23:1 , כִּתִּיי֯ם 23:12 ; כִּתִּים (as son of Yawan) Gen 10:4 = 1Chr 1:7 ; כ ׳מִיַּד וְצִים Num 24:24 ships from the side (direction) of Kittim ; more Generally, of coast-lands of Mediterranean, כִּתִּיִּים אִיֵּי Jer 2:10 , כִּתִּיִּם אִיֵּי Ezek 27:6 ; even of Macedonian Greece, כִּתִּים צִיִּים Dan 11:30 (only here as adjective, compare Bev) i.e. Grecian ships. כָּתִית see below כתת . כתל (√ of following; compare Arabic make into firm lumps or blocks, make compact ; Frey also bind, imprison , be joined together ).
